steps.code:
# Get access token from login
access_token = login_response["access_token"]

# Fetch all friends using pagination
all_friends = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    friends_page = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not friends_page:
        break
    all_friends.extend(friends_page)
    if len(friends_page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("Total friends:", len(all_friends))
print("First few friends:", all_friends[:3])

from datetime import datetime
